brief: The canvas simulates the viewfinder of a retro Nokia N900 camera. The screen is dominated by a pixellated, greenish view of a scene, complete with simulated camera information overlays like a flash indicator and focus box. Subtle analog static and minor flickering movement perpetually animate the background, giving the impression of a live feed. When the user clicks anywhere on the screen, the camera immediately captures the scene, displaying a moment of brief digital processing. This processing moment shifts the visual output from a raw viewfinder view to a stylized, AI-enhanced interpretation of the captured image, before smoothly resetting the viewfinder.

statement: This sketch recreates the experience of using a retro Nokia N900 camera's viewfinder, complete with simulated analog static, flickering movement, and camera effects. The interface displays a pixellated greenish scene that subtly shifts and moves to simulate a live feed, while overlaying authentic camera information like a flash indicator and focus box. When clicked, the viewfinder captures the scene and transitions through a digital processing animation before resetting to its live view state, mimicking the behavior of the original device's capture cycle.
